    Welcome!

    I am a first-year PhD student at the University of Lille, supervised by Jenny Sorce (cosmologist at CNRS) and Pierre-Antoine Thouvenin (associate professor at Centrale Lille). I work in the Centre de Recherche en Informatique, Signal et Automatique de Lille (CRIStAL) laboratory as part of the SigMA team. My PhD project is funded by the ANR Chaire WILL UNIVERSITWINS hold by Jenny Sorce and Klaus Dolag (computational astrophysicist at LMU Munich).

    My research focuses on solving inverse problems applied in cosmology, especially on galaxy clusters, through Bayesian inference.

    PhD thesis title: Bayesian Estimate of Galaxy Clusters for Improved Cosmological Parameter Inference.
